name: Art Manion
biography: is a senior member of the Vulnerability Analysis team in the CERT Program at the Software Engineering Institute (SEI). He has studied vulnerabilities and coordinated responsible disclosure efforts since joining CERT in 2001. Manion currently focuses on vulnerability discovery and other areas of applied research, including ways to improve operational vulnerability response. Prior to joining the SEI, Manion was the Director of Network Infrastructure at Juniata College.
